_note: Saved views and tours for the vote-terrain page; read by js/views.js and tools/vote-terrain/export.mjs. A view's state uses the address-hash keys (see js/state.js); keys left out take the page defaults. Captions carry no typed numbers: every figure is a {token} resolved from the data (see the header of js/views.js). Optional per view: snapshot (a slug in snapshots/), file (the card's typed file line; the title when absent).

views.title: What a vote is worth, 2024
views.file: Electoral weight per vote cast, by county; President 2024
views.caption: In 2024 a vote cast in {calc.eff.pres2024.hiName} carried {calc.eff.pres2024.ratio|x} the electoral weight of a vote cast in {calc.eff.pres2024.loName}. Height is votes scaled by each state's electoral votes per vote cast; colour is the weight of one vote against the national average.
views.sources: 2020 Census population and apportionment; ACS 2019-2023 citizen voting-age population special tabulation; {elections.pres2024.source}

views.title: The smallest change, 2024
views.file: Net margin by county, President 2024; the three states that decided it
views.caption: {bal.elections.pres2024.smallest.president.votes|n} voters switching from {bal.elections.pres2024.president.winner|last} to {bal.elections.pres2024.president.runner|last} would have changed the 2024 presidency: {bal.elections.pres2024.smallest.president.per_state|perstate}.
views.sources: Map: {elections.pres2024.source} Votes: half each state's certified margin plus one, closest states first, from the FEC, {bal.sources.fecpres2024}. Electoral votes: National Archives.

views.title: The 2026 Senate races, from the west
views.file: Votes per square mile and swing by county; Senate 2026, unofficial
views.caption: Colour is each county's swing since the previous race for the same Senate seat; the faint grid is that race's land, showing where fewer votes were cast this time.

views.title: Every House district, 2026

Unofficial count as of {house.asof2026|et}.

views.caption: Republicans won {house.states.2024.TX.seatsR} of Texas's {house.states.2024.TX.districts} House seats in 2024 on the lines then in use. At the default plausible swing, {calc.house.2024.st.TX.captured} of the {house.states.2024.TX.districts} were captured, whichever party won them, and {calc.house.2024.st.TX.atRisk} at risk.

views.title: Texas House districts, 2026
views.file: Texas House districts by margin, 2026, unofficial
views.caption: Republicans won or led in {house.states.2026.TX.seatsR} of Texas's {house.states.2026.TX.districts} House seats in 2026, on the lines in use that year. At the default plausible swing, {calc.house.2026.st.TX.captured} of the {house.states.2026.TX.districts} are captured, whichever party holds them, and {calc.house.2026.st.TX.atRisk} at risk. Unofficial count as of {house.asof2026|et}.

views.title: Captured votes, House 2024

views.title: Residents per House seat, since 1910

The House was fixed at {hist.cap.seats|raw} seats in {calc.hist.capYear|raw}. In {calc.hist.last.year|raw} a member from {calc.hist.lastHiName} represented {calc.hist.lastHiV|n} people and one from {calc.hist.lastLoName} {calc.hist.lastLoV|n}.

A vote cast in {calc.hist.wLastHiName} carried {calc.hist.wLast.ev.ratio|x} the electoral weight of one cast in {calc.hist.wLastLoName} in {calc.hist.wLast.year|raw}; in {calc.hist.wFirst.year|raw} the widest gap was {calc.hist.wFirst.ev.ratio|x}, {calc.hist.wFirstHiName} against {calc.hist.wFirstLoName}.

views.title: Swing simulator, 2024
views.file: One swing for every race on Nov. 5, 2024: where control changes hands
views.caption: On a uniform swing, a simplification and not a forecast: the House changes hands at {calc.sim.y2024.house.toD.other.at|pt} points of margin toward Democrats, the Electoral College at {calc.sim.y2024.pres.toD.other.at|pt}, when {calc.sim.y2024.pres.toD.other.states|states} flip, and the Senate at {calc.sim.y2024.sen.toD.other.at|pt}.
views.sources: FEC, official 2024 presidential results (certified state totals); National Archives, electoral votes; MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2024 Senate by state (unofficial file version); Clerk of the House, 2024 election statistics. Swing in points of two-party margin.

views.title: Swing simulator, House 2026
views.file: One swing for every House race on Nov. 3, 2026, unofficial: captured seats stay put
views.caption: On the unofficial count and a uniform swing, a simplification and not a forecast: the Democratic House majority holds until {calc.sim.y2026.house.toR.first.at|pt} points of margin toward Republicans, and Republicans reach 218 at {calc.sim.y2026.house.toR.other.at|pt}. At the default plausible swing of {calc.sim.y2026.swing.ps} points toward Republicans, {calc.sim.y2026.swing.toR.n} seats change hands. At {calc.sim.range|raw} points, the slider's limit, {calc.sim.y2026.swing.edgeR.n} do: {calc.sim.y2026.swing.edgeR.atRisk} from the at-risk band, {calc.sim.y2026.swing.edgeR.contestable} contestable and {calc.sim.y2026.swing.edgeR.captured} captured. Unofficial count as of {house.asof2026|et}.
views.sources: AP via CNN, 2026 House and Senate results, unofficial as of {house.asof2026|et}. Swing in points of two-party margin.

views.title: The weight of a vote, by state, 2024
views.file: Electoral weight of one vote, by state, in three parts; President 2024
views.caption: In 2024 each vote cast in {calc.power.pres2024.rank.hiName} carried {calc.power.pres2024.rank.hi.r|x2} the national average electoral weight, and each vote cast in {calc.power.pres2024.rank.loName} {calc.power.pres2024.rank.lo.r|x2}. In {calc.power.pres2024.rank.hiName} the state's electoral votes per resident account for {calc.power.pres2024.rank.hi.B|x2}, residents per eligible citizen for {calc.power.pres2024.rank.hi.N|x2} and eligible citizens per vote cast for {calc.power.pres2024.rank.hi.T|x2}; the three multiply to the state's weight.
views.sources: 2020 Census population and apportionment; ACS 2019-2023 citizen voting-age population special tabulation; {elections.pres2024.source}

views.title: Votes and electoral votes, by state, 2024
views.file: Each state's share of the electoral votes; President 2024
views.caption: Each square is the state's share of the electoral votes in 2024. {calc.power.pres2024.tiles.hi.name} cast {calc.power.pres2024.tiles.hi.votes|pct2} of the votes counted here and holds {calc.power.pres2024.tiles.hi.ev|pct2} of the electoral votes; {calc.power.pres2024.tiles.lo.name} cast {calc.power.pres2024.tiles.lo.votes|pct2} and holds {calc.power.pres2024.tiles.lo.ev|pct2}.
views.sources: {elections.pres2024.source} Electoral votes: National Archives, 2020 apportionment. Alaska is left out: the page has no county votes for it.

views.title: Where each party's votes live, 2024

views.caption: In 2024, {calc.power.pres2024.conc.q|raw}% of Democratic votes came from {calc.power.pres2024.conc.d.n|n} of {calc.power.pres2024.conc.d.of|n} counties, holding {calc.power.pres2024.conc.d.land|pct} of the land in counties with results.
